conf.description: Zeek / Corelight notice / csv-file (TSV ASCII writer): header-driven tab split (fixed default column order) then logs-zeek.notice@custom-equivalent ECS mapping. Direct route, no guard hop.

conf.comment: Zeek notice.log (TSV/ASCII writer) -> logs-zeek.notice. Splits on tab per the Zeek 6.0/7.0 LTS default notice.log column order (fixed list, see README gap). Per logs-zeek.notice@custom: coalesce src/id.orig_h into source.ip and dst/id.resp_h into destination.ip (picking one loses host-scoped notices); p is the map's only source for an additional destination.port when id.resp_p is absent, coalesced the same way; peer_descr is the only in-band sensor identity (-> observer.name); dropped only means something when a blocking framework is wired up. event.dataset=zeek.notice.

functions.description: discard Zeek ASCII-writer header/meta lines (#separator, #fields, #types, #path, #open, #close, ...) - they carry no event data

conf.code: (function(){var HEADER=["ts", "uid", "id_orig_h", "id_orig_p", "id_resp_h", "id_resp_p", "fuid", "file_mime_type", "file_desc", "proto", "note", "msg", "sub", "src", "dst", "p", "n", "peer_descr", "actions", "email_dest", "suppress_for", "remote_location_country_code", "remote_location_region", "remote_location_city", "remote_location_latitude", "remote_location_longitude", "dropped", "community_id"];var ARRAY_COLS={"actions": true, "email_dest": true};var vals=__e['_raw']?__e['_raw'].split('\t'):[];for(var i=0;i<HEADER.length;i++){var name=HEADER[i];var v=vals[i];if(v===undefined||v==='-'){continue;}if(v==='(empty)'){v='';}__e[name]=(ARRAY_COLS[name]&&v!=='')?v.split(','):v;}})();

functions.description: split the tab-delimited data line per Zeek's default notice.log column order (dotted columns id.orig_h and remote_location.country_code etc. renamed to their underscore equivalents to avoid a dotted raw field name as a path-based target); actions and email_dest are set_separator ',' vectors and become arrays here
batch rename of clean 1:1 mapped fields with no value transform
implement every partial/unmapped transform from the data map (coalesces, geo_point assembly, event.outcome/action), set _time from ts, tag event.dataset, then remove the now-superseded raw columns
